stem:
A group of 64 children and 24 adults will travel to a zoo in vans. There will be 8 people in each van.

How many vans will be needed to take the group to the zoo?

text: How many vans will be needed to take the group to the zoo?
difficulty_rationale: The problem requires a simple addition and division to find the number of vans needed, a straightforward calculation suitable for grade 3 level.
